Hi Sam — great to get the numbers, and thanks for the attachment. Quick read below with ballpark economics and a few clarifying questions. I attached a short Redwood_Pricing_Scenarios.pdf with examples.

Ballpark per-model unit economics (hosted API, list-rate):
- Chat (high-quality chat model): $1,200 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (per 1M token equivalent): $300 / 1M tokens
- Rerank (low-latency reranking path): $1,400 / 1M tokens

Notes: these are list numbers for hosted; committed Dedicated pricing typically gets 25–50% off depending on term and commit size.

Example effective spend (monthly, no discounts) using your mix (170M total):
- Chat 70% => 119M tokens -> ~$142.8k
- Embeddings 20% => 34M tokens -> ~$10.2k
- Rerank 10% => 17M tokens -> ~$23.8k
- Estimated monthly list spend: ~$176.8k

If you’re targeting a monthly budget of $30k–$75k, that implies either: a) much smaller spend footprint initially (pilot), b) a large committed discount (Dedicated/reserved), or c) model/ops changes (quantization, shorter contexts, more caching).

Questions to help narrow pricing scenarios:
1) What % of chat tokens are long-context ( > 2k tokens ) vs short (<=512)? That materially affects cost and model choice.
2) How many embedding vectors / sec (for throughput/throughput pricing) and average input length?
3) Is accuracy parity with your current model provider required for GA, or are you open to a pilot with slightly lower-quality variants (i.e., quantized or distilled models) to validate economics?

Quick recommendations:
- Consider an initial pilot on Redwood Hosted with a 3-month committed volume to get 30–40% off list while you validate quality.
- Use prefix caching and response truncation strategies where possible to reduce per-token consumption.
- For embeddings-heavy workloads, we often recommend a hybrid: Redwood embeddings engine (quantized) + a cache for repeated vectors.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to run through a few committed scenarios (e.g., $30k/mo commit, $50k/mo, $100k/mo) and show net effective $/1M.

Best,
